title: Crafting Team Excellence
Content:
Morning Sessions:

9:30 AM — Team Building Session to CONNECT
1. Team Formation
- Description: Name your team, build its identity and pride. Uncover hidden talents within members and explore new possibilities together.
- Learning Outcomes: Self Awareness & Team Talents/Strengths

2. Colored Numbers
- Description: Teams race to form the winning group, emphasizing assertiveness and agility.
- Learning Outcomes: Team Dynamics: Be Adaptable, Everyone has values to team success, whether it's a big role or a small one.

3. Likes/Dislikes
- Description: Participants explore similarities and differences, highlighting the uniqueness of each individual.
- Learning Outcomes: Team Bonding: Understand each other and then, be understood. It's an essential process to build a strong team.

10:30 AM — Art Session to CREATE
Pine Wood Slice Painting
- Description: Embark on a hands-on adventure to unleash your creativity on unconventional canvases to express your unique perspective and find beauty in unexpected materials.
- Learning Outcomes: Team Creativity: To learn and discover each unique talent as well as to de-stress which is key towards creativity.

Afternoon Session:

1:00 PM — Team Building Session to CONNECT
1. Sembang-Sembang
- Description: Team members take turns sharing about 3 areas of their life, fostering care and admiration within the group.
- Learning Outcomes: Team moments: Sharing and inspiring each other. Build confidence and trust among team members.

2. Yellow Rope
- Description: Using a yellow rope, participants prove that nothing is impossible with determination.
- Learning Outcomes: Team Achievements: Working together in overcoming obstacles together and learning from the process.

3. Beam Balance
- Description: Teams plan, design, and construct an engineering wonder, focusing on communication, planning, and execution.
- Learning Outcomes: Communication & Teamwork: Learn by doing, it's a more effective way to learn.

4. Body Gymnastics
- Description: Teams communicate to create three human shapes, emphasizing the role of physics.
- Learning Outcomes: Agility & Teamwork: Learning to be agile and nothing is impossible.

5. Whacky Hit
- Description: Using a quirky tool, tackle the challenges in this thrilling game of Whacky Hit!
- Learning Outcomes: Unity, all working towards a single mission.

6. Animal Farm
- Description: Participants find others making the same animal sound, encouraging creativity and active listening.
- Learning Outcomes: Fun & Relaxing game, to illustrate how important communication is in team dynamics.

title: ATV Adventure Tour
Content:
1. ATV Tour (Double Rider)
- Description: Feel the drive of Riding an ATV while taking the view to see the scenery of the Paddy Field, Scenery of the Village view, Fish Pond, Fruit Farm, and Small Forests
- Details: Guided by a Marshall during the tour | Duration: 2 Hours+
- Features: Mangrove Tree, Sunset View, Paddy Field

2. Archery (Indoor)
- Description: Compete individually or in groups in a archery stand-off. Learn from the best and utilize those skills in archery-themed challenges.
- Details: Learn the basics from a guide | Duration: 2 Hours+
- Features: Fun Environment, Assigned Guide

3. Batik Painting
- Description: Batik painting is a very relaxed activity. Participants will get one batik frame tool and coloring. An instructor will demonstrate how to mix the correct color and its up you to create the best batik.
- Details: Learn the steps from an instructor | Duration: 2 Hours+
- Features: Comfy Studio, Instructor

4. Horse Riding
- Description: Come join us in the stables with our well-trained horses and passionate trainers. Learn how to interact with a horse and make life-long bonds along the way.
- Details: Learn the steps from an instructor | Duration: 2 Hours+ | Safety Equipment Provided
- Features: Ride Comfortably, Gentle Horses

title: Collaborative Excellence with Mechanical Keyboard Building
Content:
The Workshop is a unique and interactive program designed to enhance team collaboration, communication, and efficiency through the exploration of mechanical keyboards. This workshop goes beyond the traditional team-building activities by incorporating a hands-on approach to learning and applying valuable skills in a fun and engaging environment. Participants will not only gain insights into the world of mechanical keyboards but also develop a deeper understanding of teamwork and communication dynamics.

Outline:

Morning Session — Mechanical Keyboard Workshop
- Registration & Morning Tea Break
- Key Agenda Topics:
  1. Overview and introduction to mechanical keyboards
  2. Fundamentals of keyboard construction
  3. Hands-on assembly and customization guided by experts, encouraging collaboration and creative problem-solving
  4. Speed typing competition
- Takeaway: Each participant keeps their custom-built wireless mechanical keyboard

Afternoon Session — Teambuilding Activities
- Focus Area: Games & Activities designed to foster team cohesion, interpersonal dynamics, and communication
- Key Highlights:
  1. Experiential exercises tailored to key learning goals like collaboration and adaptability
  2. 3–4 guided team challenge activities led by experienced facilitators
  3. Practical lessons on teamwork delivered through an engaging, interactive environment

title: The EQ Edge: Driving Engagement & High Performance
Content:
Overview:
Studies have revealed that people with high EQ are often the most successful in their personal lives as well as their careers. EQ plays a huge part in Employee Engagement and getting employees to be innovative, creative, and think out of the box for excellent problem-solving and decision-making.

Key Benefits & Objectives:
- Enhance strategies and understand the components of High EQ for Employee Engagement.
- Utilize personal strengths to enhance the organization.
- Learn to read Big 5 Personality Profiles using the LPI Model.

Schedule & Outlines:

DAY 1:
Morning Session:
- Registration & Opening Keynote: Setting the stage; Perception & Self-Talk; Intrapersonal and Interpersonal Skills; Case Study Video (High EQ vs. Low EQ)
- Session 1: Emotional Intelligence Quotient (EQ) in Action: Personality Profiling – LPI Model (the Big 5), Creative Imaginator, Team Profile Combinations, Case Study Videos (Recognising Profiles)
- Session 2: EQ through Personality Inventory: Understanding Socio-Emotional Security & Significance in self and employees; Case Study on Security & Significance

Afternoon Session:
- Session 2 (Continued): EQ through Personality Inventory
- Session 3: Personality of the Person / Leader
- Forum Discussion & Q&A: Discuss Learnings
- Closing Keynote: Recap of key insights for Day 1

DAY 2:
Morning Session:
- Registration & Opening Keynote: Setting the stage for Day 2
- Session 4: Perception and Stress: Happiness Chemicals and How to Get Them; Thankfulness & Self-Pity Chart; Real-Life Case Studies
- Session 5: Emotional Excellence and Emotional Intelligence of the Person / Leader: Emotional intelligence in the workplace and addressing its scarcity

Afternoon Session:
- Session 6: The Emotionally Excellent Innovative and Creative Person / Leader: Optimizing Self-Development; Enriching Interpersonal Skills; Organizational Application
- Forum Discussion & Q&A: Discuss Learnings
- Closing Keynote: Recap of key insights for Day 2

Speakers:
- Chee Kok Beng (Principal Consultant & Trainer)
- Koay Kheng Huat (Organization Transformation Leader)

title: Microsoft Excel Basic to Intermediate
Content:
This course is designed to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of Microsoft Excel, from basic to intermediate levels. Participants will learn how to efficiently set up and manage worksheets, format data, use formulas, print data, and utilize various features to enhance productivity. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped with the skills needed to navigate and use Excel for various tasks, including data analysis and presentation.

Outline:

Day 1: Basic Excel Skills

Module A: Setting Up a Worksheet
- Identify the Elements of the Excel Interface
- Creating a New Worksheet with Data
- Using AutoFill for Data Entry
- Making Changes to Data
- Navigating and Selecting Cell Ranges Quickly
- Splitting Windows Horizontally or Vertically
- Freezing Windows Screen

Module B: Modifying Excel Worksheet
- Inserting, Deleting, Copying Worksheets
- Renaming and Coloring Worksheet Tabs
- Changing Order of Worksheets
- Working with Multiple Sheets
- Navigating Worksheets in a Workbook
- Hiding/Unhiding Worksheets

Module C: Formatting Data
- Formatting Data in a Worksheet
- Making Worksheet Contents Less Crowded by Changing Column Width and Row Height
- Inserting or Copying Columns/Rows with Insert or Paste Options
- Adding Comments to Data

Module D: Writing Formulas
- Entering Simple Formulas in Worksheet
- Using AutoSum to Calculate Total, Average, Max, Min, etc.
- Using AutoCalculate as a Calculator

Module E: Printing Data
- Printing Worksheets
- Changing Page Orientation, Margin, and Scaling
- Inserting Headers & Footers
- Inserting Page Breaks

Day 2: Intermediate Excel Skills

Module F: Sign In to Office and OneDrive
- Sign In
- Saving a Workbook to OneDrive

Module G: Protecting Workbook
- Protecting Worksheets, Workbooks, and Files
- Exercise: Protecting Worksheets with Hidden Formulas
- Exercise: Protecting Workbooks and Files

Module H: Analyzing Your Data Instantly
- Analyze Your Data Instantly

Module I: Presenting Data in Charts
- Creating Charts
- Modifying Charts
- Recommended Charts

Module J: Working with Sparklines
- Types of Sparklines
- Creating Sparklines
- Changing the Appearance of Sparklines
- Changing the Display Range
